title: Frank & Jade
description: Jade Dubois, 29 years old, employee at Banque Populaire, searches through her partner Frank's phone after seeing a suspicious notification. She's going to discover that his real name is actually Samuel Vasseur,

questions.question: I'm shaking all over... I know he's talking to someone in his Messages app, tell me what this file is about.
Plans? Why would a lawyer have that... Last night, he came home at 2 AM. Please check his Google Maps, where was he yesterday?
questions.hint: Search for a location on Google Maps.

questions.question: Quai Perrache? That's a sketchy industrial area, there's nothing there... Why would he lie to me about something like that? Look for any trace of money movement last night. If he withdrew cash or paid for something during the evening, give me the exact amount.
49,90€.. Please try to see what exactly it is, I want to know what he ordered yesterday.
questions.hint: Cross-reference the payment with recent purchases by email

questions.question: A kit for picking locks? What's this madness... He never told me he was interested in that. Try to find out what type of locks he's interested in, tell me which one
I'm starting to get really scared now. Why would he learn to force this kind of locks? And while we're at it, take a look at the monthly charges, the most recent one, tell me what it is.
What? How is that possible? We don't even have a car... Find the brand and its model.
questions.hint: Look at the purchase description on Revolut

questions.question: An Audi RS4? Why is he paying for a car I've never seen? Look for the license plate, I'm going to note that down.
questions.hint: Look for a suspicious conversation on WhatsApp.

questions.question: Wait... tell me what first name is written on this contract?

Samuel Ortega? I don't understand... We've been together for a year, wouldn't I know his identity? Look somewhere in his drive for an ID document, usually his password is 986500. Give me his last name and first name.
questions.hint: To find the date of their first date, look at their old messages

questions.question: Samuel Ortega.. I feel like I've been living with a stranger for a year. If he's not a lawyer and he's lying about everything, there must be a trace of his real life. Search through his private files. Tell me where he was before we met.
questions.hint: You need to open the private folders, the pattern password is linked to their identity.

questions.question: Oh my God... I... I want to scream. I'm locked up with a criminal. Look for the document that explains his conviction, I want to know exactly what he did.
questions.hint: Look at the folder or conviction details.

questions.question: A robber... And getting back to those famous technical plans from the suspicious message at the beginning with "M"... try to find out which bank these plans correspond to.
questions.hint: Go back to messages with 'M', they give a meeting location, search with calendar and Google Maps.

questions.question: That's my branch! He must have sneakily taken a document from my desk. Tell me what he photographed. It's surely hidden in his hidden photos!
questions.hint: Go to hidden photos in the Photos app.

questions.question: Oh yeah, I really got played... Look at the exact time this photo of the schematics was taken.
questions.hint: Look at the exact time the photo was taken in the metadata.

questions.question: If he took these photos in the middle of the night, it means he's been planning this for a while... he surely already prepared a plan to cover himself after the heist. If you find a file that could cover for him, give me the file name.
A confession letter? But I don't understand... why would Samuel have that? Please open this document. Tell me what first and last name appear as the signature.
questions.hint: Look at who signed the letter.

questions.question: What? He signed with my name? But... that means he wrote this in my place! He's making me take the fall for his heist! Tell me what excuse he invented in this letter to justify my need for money?
questions.hint: Search for the reason for the robbery in messages or notes

questions.question: He's really a... oh! He just got out of the shower! I have to leave. Quick, find the first and last name of his accomplice, Mr "M", hurry!
questions.hint: Connect the phone number of M with Safari. Then you can go to Gmail to find out more and finally to Calendar.

textSuccess: He's really a... oh! He just got out of the shower! I have to go. Thanks for everything, I have all the evidence now. Samuel Vasseur, Michael Kroll... I'm heading to the police station before it's too late. I can't believe he manipulated me like that for a year...

onboardingContent.text: Hi... You don't know me but I really need help. My name is Jade and I'm in a horrible situation with my boyfriend Frank.
Frank and I have been together for 3 years. I thought I knew him inside out... We were even talking about getting married soon.
But for the past few weeks, he's been acting really weird. He goes out without telling me where, gets suspicious calls... I saw a notification on his phone that made my blood run cold.
He forgot his phone at home this morning. I know it's wrong but... I need to know the truth. Can you help me search through it? I'm terrified of what I'm going to find.

files.name: Confession_Letter.pdf
files.content:
# Confession Letter - Jade Dubois

To the attention of the Public Prosecutor,

I, the undersigned, Jade Dubois, acknowledge having participated in the robbery of the Banque Populaire branch located at 214 rue de la République in Lyon, on July 26, 2026.

I had no choice left, I had to repay my gambling debts. This is why I agreed to provide the building plans and alarm access codes to my accomplices.

I take full responsibility for my actions and am ready to cooperate with the authorities to reduce the consequences of this matter.

I deeply regret my actions.

Sincerely,
Jade Dubois

Signed in Lyon, July 17, 2026.

files.name: Conviction_Aggravated_Theft_Robbery.pdf
files.content:
# Conviction – Aggravated theft and robbery

Judgment rendered on May 20, 2024 by the Lyon Court of Appeals (criminal division).
Details: aggravated theft and robbery in a Lyon store on October 11, 2023. Amount stolen: 23,490 euros. Sentence: 6 years imprisonment; minimum term of 2 years; prohibition from conducting business activity for 5 years.
Reasons: evidence, witness testimony and surveillance videos.

Appeal: possible appeal within 10 days.

files.name: Prison_Entry_Montluc.md
files.content:
# Prison Entry – Montluc

Entry date: September 12, 2021
Location: Lyon, Montluc Prison
Context: Pretrial detention in connection with a theft and robbery case.
Arrival conditions: Identification, search, placement in cell. Sector A was assigned.
Timeline:
- September 9, 2021: search and arrest
- September 12, 2021: official entry
- September 16, 2021: initial medical consultation

Visits and calls under surveillance were regular. Medical-psychological follow-up was established and support measures were offered.
